title: Men in Suits on University Campus, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Two men wearing dark suits stand on a grassy lawn on what appears to be a university campus in March 1966, as stamped on the right-hand margin. One man holds an identification badge or pass. In the background, a Romanesque Revival collegiate brick building stands behind mature trees, with a dispersed crowd of students and attendees gathered along a walkway, reflecting the formal campus dress codes and atmosphere of the mid-1960s.
